run_rerank_text: run text-only reranking via /rerank endpoint with query and document list
run_score_text: run text-only scoring via /score endpoint with query and multiple documents
run_score_text_top_n: run text reranking with top_n filtering to return only the most relevant results
run_rerank_multimodal: run multimodal reranking with text query and image documents via /rerank endpoint
run_main: run all reranking and scoring examples sequentially via main entry point
